requirements.text: At startup, require administrator authentication with ID 'a' and passcode 'b'; allow two login attempts and terminate after two failures.
requirements.source_quote: - At startup, require administrator authentication. For this experiment, use admin ID "a" and passcode "b". Allow two login attempts; terminate after two failures.

requirements.text: After successful login, enable administrator to add multiple organizations, each with a unique name, base fare, price per minute, price per mile, and minimum fare.
requirements.source_quote: - After successful login, allow the administrator to add multiple organizations. Each organization has a unique name, base fare, price per minute, price per mile, and minimum fare.

requirements.text: All four pricing values (base fare, per-minute, per-mile, minimum) must be between 0.10 and 50.00 inclusive; invalid inputs like '3abc' must be rejected and require replacement.
requirements.source_quote: - Each of the four pricing values must be between 0.10 and 50.00 inclusive. Reject invalid values and request a replacement without accepting partial numbers such as "3abc".

submitted_requirements.text: At startup, require administrator authentication with ID 'a' and passcode 'b'; allow two login attempts and terminate after two failures.
After successful login, enable administrator to add multiple organizations, each with a unique name, base fare, price per minute, price per mile, and minimum fare.
All four pricing values (base fare, per-minute, per-mile, minimum) must be between 0.10 and 50.00 inclusive; invalid inputs like '3abc' must be rejected and require replacement.
